A '''military exploration ship''' affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] left on a mission to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] to search for [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] supply [[Planet/Legends|planets]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The ship stumbled upon the [[O'reen system/Legends|O'reen system]] and its main planet, [[O'reen]]. Upon landing on the world, the ship's crew were taken as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] by the native [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[O'reenian]]s. The [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Morningfire]] later mounted a rescue of the troops, an [[Rescue on O'reen|assault]] during which the [[Unidentified Magnus (Clone Wars invasion)|leader]] of the planet, known as the [[Magnus (title)|Magnus]], was [[Death/Legends|killed]]. The incident convinced the [[Unidentified Magnus (post-Clone Wars rescue)|subsequent ruler]] of O'reen to further isolate the planet from [[The galaxy/Legends|the outside galaxy]].<ref name="UR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
